generalCriterionList.description: To qualify for award of this contract, each tenderer in its name should have in the last five years period from 2021-22 to 2025-26

Achieved in at least Two financial years an average financial turnover of Rs.29.90 Lakhs (Usually not less than the estimated annual payments under this contract.) in the last five years period from 2021-22 to 2025-26
Mandating satisfactory completion as a prime contractor for at least one similar work an extent of 50% of the cost of the work Rs 14.95 Lakhs, in the last five years period from 2021-22 to 2025-26

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

liquid assets and or availability of credit facilities of no less than Rs.7.58 Lakhs (Credit lines/ letters of credit/ certificates from banks for meeting the fund requirement etc. (Unconditional LOC)

tenderSubEstimateList.subEstimateName: Purchasing of Pump Motor, cable and galvanized mild steel tubes for Water Section, Chandapura Town Municipal Council Limit

itemList.description: Providing,supplying to work site, Submersible Pump Set of 150mm dia suitable for bore well and confirming to IS 8034-2000;3Phase, SS Bowl & Impeller with Low volt Motor as per specifications,as per necessary ammendments and instructions of engineer incharge of work. 20.00 HP - 135 LPM @ 350 m = 25 STG Outlet Dia - 2.00" (P153/Ino: 13.20.5)

Supplying and drawing 3core flat PVC sheathed submersible pump cable manufactured with electrolytic grade copper with flexible copper with low resistance conductor confirming to 13:8130-1984 and virgin grade PVC insulation and powder coating extruded PVC sheathed suitable for working voltage upto 1100 Volts as per IS-694:1990. 3C x 6 mm2 (P 07/Ino: 2.6.3 Vol VI)
Supply and delivery at site of brand new best make gate valve as per IS 778/1984 with ISI Mark and as per its latest amendments Size 50 mm (P154/Ino: 13.24.1)
Supply and delivery at site of brand new best make non-return valve as per IS 778/1984 with ISI Mark and as per its latest amendments  Size 50mm (P154/Ino: 13.25.1)

Supply and delivery of galvanized mild steel tubes of 6mtr standard length heavy duty (C Class) as per IS 1239 (Part-I) 1990 with latest amendments with ISI Mark (one end fitted with Heavy Duty collar and other end fitted with protective cover) 50 mm dia(P.No. 155, It.No. 13.27.1 of CSR 2023-24 Volume V)

Supply, installing,testing and commissioning COMMON control panel consisting of the following INCOMING:1 No set of Phase indicating lamps with SFU of suitable rating 1 No, Analog Ammeter, 1 No Analog Voltmeter 1ni with Phase selector switch, Isolating switch OUTGOING for Main Electrical Pump: 1 No. MCB 1 No. DOL of S/D Starter suitable for respective HP 1 No. Electrcal Protection Like single Phase preventor, under voltage over Volage, under current over current & dry run protection suitable for the pump described above 1 no Indoor type NOTE: 1) DOLDirect Online Starter 2) S-D- Star Delta Starter (06 to 15 hp)(P154/Ino: 13.24.3)
